paite: Huan hipi adaih nung in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Mosi leh siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar ahoupih a,
heading: Kisimpi Nihna
english: It happened after the plague, that Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

paite: "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, a-inkuan dungzui un Israel gam a galdou thei chiang teng sim vek un," achi hi.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go forth to war in Israel.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah amaute ahoupih a,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Mipite kum sawmnih a pan atunglamte sim un," TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante kiang a thu apiak bang in, achi uhi.
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Israel ta upapen Reuben: Reuben tapate: Hanok suan Hanok inkote, Pallu suan Pallu inkote.
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

paite: Hezron suan Hezron inkote, Karmi suan Karmi inkote.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

paite: Hiaite Reubente inkuante ahi uh. Sim a om tengteng singli sangthum zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

paite: Pallu suan Eliab.
english: The sons of Pallu: Eliab.

paite: Eliab suante: Neumuel, Dathan leh Ahiram ahi uh. Hiai Dathan leh Abiram ahi ua, TOUPA ahehsak lai ua Mosi leh Aaron kalh a Korah pawl a tel omkhawmte.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called of the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against Yahweh,

paite: Huai pawl asih lai un lei in akam aka a, Korahte toh avalhkhawm a; mei in mi zanih-le-sawmnga akattum lai in, huchi in chiamtehna ana hita uhi.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; what time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

paite: Himahleh Korah tapate asi kei uh.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

paite: Simeon tapate inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a asuante uh: Nemuel suan Nemuel inkote, Jamin suan Jamin inkote, Jakin suan Jakin inkote,
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

paite: Zerah suan Zerah inkote, Shaul suan Shaul inkote ahi uh.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

paite: Hiaite Simeon suante ahi ua, singnih sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Gad tapate: Zephon suan Zephon inkote, Haggi suan Haggi inkote leh Shuni suan Shuni inkote,
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

paite: Ozni suan Ozni inkote, Eri suan Eri inkote;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

paite: Arod suan Arod inkote leh Areli suan Areli inkote.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Gad tapate suante ahi ua, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

paite: Judah tapate: Er leh Onan ahi a, huan Kanaan gam ah Er leh Onan asi uhi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

paite: Judah suante inkuan paidan hichibang ahi: Shelah suan Shelah inkote,
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

paite: leh Perez suan Perez inkote: Zer suan Zer inkote, Hezron suan Hezron inkote; Hamul suan Hamul inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Judah tapate suante ahi ua, singsagih sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were numbered of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Issakar suante: Tola suan Tola inkote, Puah suan Puah inkote,
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

paite: Jashub suan Jashub inkote, Shimron suan Shimron inkote ahi uh.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Issakar tapate suante ahi ua, singguk sangli-le-zathum ahi.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Zebulun suante: Sered suan Sered inkote, Elon suan Elon inkote, Jahleel suan Jahleel inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Zebulunte suante ahi ua, singguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Joseph suante: Manasseh leh Ephraim.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

paite: Manasseh suante: Makir suan Makir inkote; Makir in Gilead asuang a, Gilead suan Gilead inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

paite: Hiaite Gilead suante ahi ua: Iezer suan Iezer inkote, Helek suan Helek inkote,
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

paite: Asriel suan Asriel inkote, Shekem suan Shekem inkote,
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

paite: Shemida suan Shemida inkote; Hepher suan Hepher inkote ahi uh.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

paite: Hepher tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanute anei a: Zelophehad tanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Hiaite Manasseh suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singnga sangnih-le-zasagih ahi.
english: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Ephraim suante ahi ua: Shuthelah suan Suthelah inkote, Beker suan Beker inkote, Tahan suan Tahan inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

paite: Hiaite Shuthelah suante ahi ua: Eran suan Eran inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Ephraim suante inkuan ahi ua, singthum sangnih-le-zanga ahi. Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Joseph suante ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Benjamin suante: Bela suan Bela inkote, Ashbel suan Ashbel inkote, Ahiram suan Ahiram inkote,
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

paite: Shupham suan Shupham inkote, Hupham suan Hupham inkote ahi uh.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

paite: Bela suante Ard leh Naaman ahi uh: Ard suan Ard inkote, Naaman suan Naaman inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel in Benjamin suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zaguk ahi.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi ua: Shuham suan Shuham inkote ahi uh. Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

paite: Saham suante tengteng asimdan bang zel un singguk sangli-le-zali ahi.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Asher suante ahi ua: Jimna suan a pan Jimna inkote, Ishvi suan a pan Ishvi inkote; Beriah suan a pan Beriah inkote.
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

paite: Beriah suan Beriah inkote: Heber suan a pan Heber inkote; Malkiel suan a pan Malkiel inkote ahi uh.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

paite: Asher tanu min Serah ahi.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

paite: Hiaite Asher tapate suan asim teng uh ahi ua, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante: Jahzeel suan a pan Jahzeel inkote; Guni suan a pan Guni inkote;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

paite: Jezer suan a pan Jezer inkote; Silem suan a pan Silem inkote ahi uh.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante ahi ua; asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zali ahi.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Hiaite Israel suante asim teng uh ahi ua, nuaiguk sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
english: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Hiaite amin zah zel ua gam hawmsak ding ahi.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

paite: Atam deuhte gam na pe tam dia, atawm deuhte gam na pe tawm deuh ding ahi. Asimdan bang in gam piak chiat ding ahi.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: to everyone according to those who were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.

paite: Himahleh aisan a gam hawm ding ahi: Apute nam min kizomdan bang zel in gam atang ding uhi.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

paite: Aisan bang zel in atam leh atawmte kiang ah gam hawm ahi ding hi,” achi hi.
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

paite: Hiai Levite, a-inkuan kizomdan bang zel ua simte ahi uh: Gershon suan a pan Gershon inkote; Kohath suan a pan Kohath inkote; Merari suan a pan Merari inkote ahi uh.
english: These are those who were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

paite: Hiaite Levi suante ahi uh: Libni inkote, Hebron inkote, Mahli inkote, Mushi inkote, Korah inkote ahi uhi.
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

paite: Kohath in Amram asuang a, Amram zi min Jokebed, Levi tanu, Aigupta gam a Levi a pan a piang ahi a, ama'n Amram lak ah Aaron leh Mosi leh asanggamnu Miriam asuang hi.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt: and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

paite: Aaron in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar asuang hi.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu in TOUPA zat louh chi meikuang azat lai un asi uhi.
english: Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

paite: Sim tengteng pasal kha khat chiang tunglam teng singnih-le-sangthum ahi. Israel mite lak ah gam hawm tang ding ahih louh ziak un Israel mite lak ah sim ahi kei uh.
english: Those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

paite: Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang a Israel suante Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in asim uh hiaite ahi uh.
english: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Himahleh hiaite lak ah Sinai gamdai a Israel mite Mosi leh siampu Aaron in asimte, khat lel leng a-omta kei hi.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: TOUPA'N gamdai ah asi ngeingei ding uh, ana chi khinta ngal a. Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua lou ngal kuamah dam a-om kei uhi.
english: For Yahweh had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. There was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
